opening.argument: The presentation solicits payment for a mining share by describing a possible output of approximately four bitcoins over three years, together with an estimated value and approximate return on investment. The speaker directly frames the purchase as mining participation: “You spend that money to buy a mining share You could possibly mine, pessimistically in the next 3 years about four bitcoins.” It also presents additional compensation for participation and referrals, stating that certain referrals produce “6% upfront and 12% passively.” The package is tied to mining returns, which are expressly discussed as returns from the mining arrangement. Although the outcomes are qualified as possible or estimated, the paid-share solicitation and referral commissions establish the relevant return-based pitch. The available evidence does not establish that any purchase, mining performance, or payout occurred.
